title: Does ISO-Grounded NFR Specification Improve LLM Code Generation? A Comparison of Rich and Structured Interventions against a Natural-Language Baseline
abstract: arXiv:2608.13742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In LLM-based code generation, Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) are often specified as terse one-line phrases. We ask whether grounding those specifications in ISO/IEC 25010 Quality Model, either as rich natural-language prose (NL-rich) or as structured JSON (Structured), improves code generated on HumanEval/HumanEval-ET compared to a RobuNFR-style one-line baseline (NL-simple). We evaluate four NFRs (performance, error handling, code smell, readability) with ten prompt variations per condition under a fixed model snapshot and paired non-parametric analysis. Primary finding: ISO-grounded enrichment improves static quality proxies (unreadability density falls across all four NFRs (e.g., Performance 0.88 -> 0.69 for NL-rich)) and reduces sensitivity to prompt wording, but does not reliably improve functional correctness; for error handling, extended-test pass rate decreases, suggesting tension between defensive coding patterns and exact

translated_title: 基于ISO的NFR规范能否提升LLM代码生成？丰富与结构化干预措施与自然语言基线的对比研究
translated_abstract: 在基于大语言模型的代码生成中，非功能需求（NFR）通常被指定为简洁的单行短语。我们探究将这些规范基于ISO/IEC 25010质量模型进行接地处理，无论是采用丰富的自然语言散文（NL-rich）还是结构化JSON（Structured），与RobuNFR风格的单行基线（NL-simple）相比，是否能够改善在HumanEval/HumanEval-ET上生成的代码。我们评估了四个NFR（性能、错误处理、代码异味、可读性），在固定模型快照和配对非参数分析下，每种条件使用十种提示变体。主要发现：基于ISO的丰富化处理改善了静态质量代理指标（四个NFR的不可读性密度均下降，例如性能从0.88降至0.69（NL-rich）），并降低了对提示措辞的敏感性，但并未可靠地提高功能正确性；对于错误处理，扩展测试通过率下降，表明防御性编码模式与精确性之间存在张力。
tldr: 基于ISO的NFR规范丰富化能提升代码静态质量并降低对提示措辞的敏感性，但无法可靠改善功能正确性，甚至可能因防御性编码模式导致错误处理场景的测试通过率下降。
en_tdlr: ISO-grounded NFR enrichment improves static code quality and reduces sensitivity to prompt wording, but fails to reliably enhance functional correctness, even decreasing extended-test pass rates for error handling due to defensive coding patterns.
